candidate_windows.window_text: We used Adam optimizer with a learning rate of $1e - 6$ , $\beta_{1} = 0.9$ , $\beta_{2} = 0.999$ , $\mathrm{eps} = 1e - 8$ , and with warm up for 500 steps for model training. The dropout rate and attention dropout are set to 0.1 and 0.1. We clip the gradient norm within 0.1. The label smoothing of NLL loss is 0.1 and weight decay is 0.01. We used max 1,024 tokens and variable batch size(≈ 15). The training epoch of the model are set to 3. At test time, we use Constrained Beam Search with 7 beams. We implemented our model using the fairseq library (Ott et al., 2019). Note that all parameters are selected based on the best performance on the development set.
